dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Every planar graph is acyclically 5-choosable.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture would imply to celebrated 5-colour theorems: one due toBorodin [B] stating that every planar graph is acyclically 5-colourable, and one due to Thomassen [T] stating that every plaanar graph is 5-choosable. This two theorems are best possible, because there are planar graphs which are not acyclically 4-colourable and others which are not 4-choosable. Borodin et al. [BFKRS] showed that every planar graph is acyclically 7-choosable.
